title: Certified Comparative Statics for Conservation-Law Equilibrium Layers, with an Application to RNA Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.29050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Implicit and equilibrium neural layers define their output as the fixed point of a map. Existing theory certifies that this fixed point exists; it does not certify how it responds to its inputs. For a conservation-law layer with order-preserving coupling we give a form-independent answer: every input-output comparative static is sign-certified if and only if the residual Jacobian is a nonsingular M-matrix, and the certified sign depends only on the sign of the occupancy derivative, so one guarantee covers Langmuir, Hill, and saturating-exponential occupancies. The M-matrix machinery is classical; the contribution is form-independence as the portable invariant, the first certified-sign sensitivity result for a layer of this class, and a sharp phase boundary at which certification is lost while the equilibrium remains well posed. translated_title: 守恒律平衡层的认证比较静态学及其在RNA干扰中的应用
translated_abstract: 隐式层与平衡层将其输出定义为某个映射的不动点。现有理论仅认证了该不动点的存在性，却未认证它如何响应输入的变化。对于具有保序耦合的守恒律层，我们给出了一个与具体函数形式无关的回答：当且仅当残差雅可比矩阵为非奇异M-矩阵时，每个输入-输出比较静态量均可获得符号认证，且认证出的符号仅取决于占用率导数的符号，因而单一保证即可同时覆盖Langmuir、Hill以及饱和指数型占用函数。M-矩阵的机制本身是经典的；本文的贡献在于将“形式无关性”确立为可移植的不变量、给出这一类层的首个认证符号敏感性结果，并刻画出一个尖锐的相变边界——在此边界处认证失效，而平衡点仍然适定。由此得到三个推论：该相变边界严格强于M-矩阵条件；竞争性……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了对于具有保序耦合的守恒律平衡层，当且仅当残差雅可比矩阵为非奇异M-矩阵时，所有输入-输出比较静态的符号均可被认证，且认证符号仅取决于占用率导数的符号，从而以单一保证覆盖多种占用函数形式，并应用于RNA干扰。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that for conservation-law equilibrium layers with order-preserving coupling, every input-output comparative static is sign-certified if and only if the residual Jacobian is a nonsingular M-matrix, with the certified sign depending only on the occupancy derivative's sign—yielding one form-independent guarantee covering multiple occupancies and an application to RNA interference.
